text: Cisco Systems, Inc. is Nasdaq-listed (CSCO). Per its 2025 proxy statement, its only disclosed 5%+ shareholders are The Vanguard Group (9.7%) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.9%), with no state or sovereign-fund shareholder identified.
